objective: Determine how many of the six specified products have no same-day availability (available_today_quantity = 0 or NULL) in the Veveri PowerTool shop in Brno.

params.store_id: lookup from stores WHERE store_name LIKE '%Veveri PowerTool%' AND city = 'Brno'
params.product_skus: For each of the six product descriptions in the instruction, identify the product_sku by matching the product family (brand, series, model) and variant properties (property_key, property_value_text) from product_variants, product_families, and product_variant_properties.
params.store_record_path: lookup record_path from stores WHERE store_id = $store_id
